[quote=coober_pedi;60211483]Here's my nation's history so far. I read and incorporated Nordheim's history into mine for roleplay purposes, hope that's okay.

"1908 - White miners from the United Regions of Nordiheim are sent northeast to mine opal from where the natives called (and still call) 'Mala Wiru Ngurrarpa,' or 'Land of the Water Stones' in Aboriginal, their language. The purpose of this mining was to gather enough material to help an Asatru 'proof show' in Midgard, the capital city of Nordiheim. Despite some initial conflicts with the natives living there, the miners were successful and built the future capital of the Borderlands of Coober Pedi: Coober Pedi City. Until 1915.

1915 - Religious wars, likely caused by tension created by the public display of the Asatru priests of Midgard, made their way to the colony Coober Pedi City was in, and civilians were murdered left and right with no good reason. This flared tensions, and although Nordiheim was able to get its act together in four years and made reforms, too, to satisfy the populace, the people of Coober Pedi City had had enough and separated from Nordiheim. They created the nation now known as 'the Borderlands of Coober Pedi,' making Coober Pedi City the capital, and created their own culture, a hybrid of Nordiheim, Aboriginal, and the rugged lifestyle of the 'Outback' of the region that the miners had perfected."

It's short for now, but I have something to go to for the next sevenish hours. But I will be thinking throughout the day about what happens next![/quote]

I kinda wish you had asked me first, there are a few flaws in you stuff when it comes to nordiheimians, but not someting we can't work out though if you want to work together :O

The 1908 part:
1) There would have been no white people left in Nordiheim at this point, only various shades of brown similar to modern times (the norse had intermaried and had children together with the native Argosians/Aboriginals for close to 2860 years by this point in time, so finding anyone with pure enough norse blood to be white skined would be basicly imposible), most likely the miners would be of "lighter skin" then the full blooded natives, and the Nordiheimians were for the most part very amendable with the natives of Argos (unless you are going for them being extreemly sett in their own religon ofcorse, then it might be a little conflict :O )

2) The religous tension would allready be high at this point, so perhaps they were "true belivers" from the Sorland region, spesificaly the people of the small patch that would be west of you if I understand you placement correctly? (would help if you made a mark on a copy of the world/Erene map to see more or less were you plan to be)

The 1915 part:
Don't have to much of a problem with this part to be honest, joust find the date and wording a bit odd/klunky :|  Maybe a bit more fleshing out could help?

And finaly I am curious what type of relationship you are tinking that our two nations had from this point(1900s) up to modern times, are we friendly, neutral or hostile?
Also, do you have discord? we could talk a bit easier there I tink.
